name: @insightflow/data-py
description: InsightFlow data service (Python, managed with uv). Scripts wrap uv for Turborepo (ADR-001).

scripts.worker: uv run watchfiles --filter python "arq app.worker.WorkerSettings" app
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
